description: 한국수력원자력(주)_재난관리자원 비축관리현황 [nuclear facilities and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 한국수력원자력은 재난관리자원을 체계적이고 효율적으로 관리하고, 재난이 발생할 우려가 있거나 발생하였을 때에 재난관리자원을 신속하고 안정적으로 동원하기 위하여 재난관리자원 비축현황을. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 재난관리, 긴급복구, 재난관리자원, 재난대응, 자원응원. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
